target:
NARRATIVE: To check if two lists of tuples are identical, I need to compare each tuple in the first list with the corresponding tuple in the second list. If all tuples match, the lists are identical. I can use a generator expression to iterate over the tuples and compare them using the `==` operator. If any tuple does not match, the expression will return `False`. If all tuples match, the expression will return `True`.

ACTION: {"expression":"all(test_list1[i] == test_list2[i] for i in range(min(len(test_list1), len(test_list2))))"}
